What a bite does

Death usually results from internal bleeding and kidney failure over 1-2+ days, not rapid collapse - the fast STRIKE is not the same as a fast death.

Antivenom source. India.

Name and taxonomy. carinatus sensu stricto.

If you are bitten

Get to a hospital that holds antivenom. Keep still, remove rings and watches, and do not cut, suck or tie off the bite. Use the red “Bitten?” button at the top of any page.
